# type = situation: the select_trigger binds scope:recipient to the situation, which is
# the one parameter the panel's row buttons supply. One action per slot and kind, because
# a button cannot pick a target. The AI never uses these (ai_tick = never).

cc_pty_bribe_1 = {
	type = situation
	price = price:cc_pty_bribe
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	
	potential = {
		scope:actor = { has_variable = cc_pty_active }
	}
	
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { cc_pty_can_bribe = { SLOT = 1 } }
	}
	
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:cc_pty_factions = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		custom_tooltip = cc_pty_tt_bribe_effect
		# The tooltip evaluates this block (hidden_effect included) without committing
		# writes; cc_pty_run_slot skips the body in that pass. See TOOLTIP GUARD.
		hidden_effect = { scope:actor = { cc_pty_run_slot = { EFFECT = cc_pty_bribe SLOT = 1 } } }
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}

cc_pty_election = {
	type = situation
	price = price:cc_pty_election
	ai_tick = never
	automation_tick = never
	
	potential = {
		scope:actor = { has_variable = cc_pty_active }
	}
	
	allow = {
		scope:actor = { cc_pty_can_call_election = yes }
	}
	
	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = situation
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_situation"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			situation:cc_pty_factions = this
			situation_is_active = yes
		}
	}
	
	effect = {
		scope:actor = {
			add_stability = stability_mild_penalty
			custom_tooltip = cc_pty_tt_election_effect
			hidden_effect = { cc_pty_run = { EFFECT = cc_pty_call_election } }
		}
	}
	
	ai_will_do = {
		add = { value = 0 }
	}
}
